verdict.rationale: Dagster's pipelines and asset definitions are plain, open-source Python code (dagster-docs-17, dagster-docs-26), which inherently avoids vendor lock-in for pipeline logic, and the project itself is open source. However, there is no explicit documentation of an export feature for run history, metadata, or the underlying job/asset catalog stored in Dagster+'s hosted database, nor any migration/export tooling described. missing for 10: explicit data/metadata export tooling, documented migration path off Dagster+, evidence about run history or asset catalog portability.
